evidence_role: Exact join of the verified unconditional M4 child and a fresh post-child aggregate runtime proof. This join prevents umbrella-only certification and is the proof body bound by the aggregate literal.
selected_profile: One hosted OutcomeRoom compiled as a bounded System; no external participant or federation claim.

unconditional_child.open_successor_hold_note: The child's closure is qualified by open successor holds (osh-0076, osh-0079..osh-0083) and projects as verified_historical_with_open_successor; its raw status authority remains verified. Those holds are discharged by their named M5-family successors, not by this aggregate.

adjacent_focused_proof.note: Stage-listed focused activation-plane check at the same commit; not the aggregate bar, retained to bind the strengthened anonymous-refusal proofs (anchor_pinned=true visible in both logs).

proven: The reusable OutcomeRoom package compiles through genesis into one active bounded System with exact package, genesis, constitution, profile, host-domain, and owner coordinates.
Room genesis and every shared transition are operation-backed through Agentgres with compare-and-swap heads, resulting roots, and receipts.
OutcomeRoom and GoalRun membership is reciprocal; detach/reattach recovery converges one canonical sequence without duplicate operations.
Minimum WorkResult and OutcomeDelta truth plus graph, discussion, product, and replay projections reconstruct at the exact state and receipt roots after restart.

Anonymous refusal is uniform and pinned: one byte-identical 401 authentication_required body across existing, missing, collection, wrong-method, never-registered-namespace, and UI-proxied probes, with the anchor's content asserted on its own terms (exact needs_bootstrap,ok,reason key set) before any equality comparison.
The unconditional room-truth/product child is independently verified with a literal-valid binding; the aggregate is not an umbrella-only claim.

unbacked_scheme_disclosure.statement: At the certified commit, agentgres:// ref branding is NOT yet substrate-backed: the scheme is constructed by string interpolation at 89 sites across 38 files outside crates/agentgres (which itself brands almost nothing), including the refs carried by events and receipts this run exercised outside the room family's canonical admission path. A ref bearing the scheme is therefore not, by itself, evidence of canonical Agentgres admission at this commit.
unbacked_scheme_disclosure.containment: scripts/check-agentgres-ref-minting.mjs (wired into check:pre-next-leg) pins every construction site in scripts/agentgres-ref-minting-baseline.v1.json; counts are monotone-decreasing and any new site fails the battery.
unbacked_scheme_disclosure.outstanding: A backed ref-minting helper in crates/agentgres and migration of backed-capable sites are sequenced AFTER this literal by owner ruling; interim self-minted planes are owned by m5-agentgres-durable-event-subscription-successor.
unbacked_scheme_disclosure.nonclaim: This aggregate's room-family transitions admit through canonical Agentgres (agentgres::mux ExactProjection) and are unaffected; this disclosure prevents the scheme itself from being read as proof of that property elsewhere.

remaining_nonclaims: Hosted admission only; no external participant or federation claim.
OutcomeRoom aggregation grants no wallet authority. Typed aggregate verification closes M4 only; it closes no other stage, P0, M9 product proof, release, or public claim.

No claim that runtime_goal_pursuit.rs or goalrun_routes.rs consumes the five ADR 0031 kernel primitives; the measured count is zero for each and remains successor work (M5.0 after m5-agentgres-durable-event-subscription-successor).
Stage certification (certify-stage M4) remains held by the open successor holds qualifying the child and canon owners; the aggregate record's typed verification does not discharge them.
